description: Pre-registered hypothesis registry for the Payout Vault research programme. All hypotheses registered before OOS data is examined. No hypothesis may be modified after registration without creating a new version.
breakeven_win_rate_note: At 3R with $7.50 round-trip cost and $1 tick value, breakeven = 1/(1+3) = 25%. Adjusted for costs: breakeven ≈ 26%.
minimum_sample_rationale: 30 trades is the minimum for a meaningful win-rate estimate (±18% CI at 95%). Below 30, the research is inconclusive regardless of win rate.
note_on_nulls: All null hypotheses are economically valid: they represent the realistic alternative that the setup has no edge above the cost-adjusted breakeven. A null of 'win rate = 50%' would be economically invalid because it ignores transaction costs.

hypotheses.name: Baseline Setup Frequency
hypotheses.description: The 4-step Payout Vault setup occurs at least 2 times per trading week on MNQ 5m bars in the OOS period.
hypotheses.primary_definition: AMB-01=3bars, AMB-04=wick, AMB-05=15m/5m, AMB-06=3bars, AMB-07=4ticks, AMB-08=proximal, AMB-09=full_range
hypotheses.null: Mean setups per week < 2.0 (insufficient frequency to generate a meaningful sample within a reasonable research window)
hypotheses.null_rationale: If the setup occurs fewer than 2 times per week, it would take more than 15 weeks to accumulate 30 trades. This is not a viable trading strategy for a prop firm account.
hypotheses.baseline: No prior frequency data available. Null is set at the minimum viable frequency for prop firm trading.
hypotheses.minimum_sample: N/A — this is a frequency test, not a performance test

hypotheses.name: Baseline Win Rate Above Breakeven
hypotheses.description: The 4-step setup achieves a win rate above the cost-adjusted breakeven (26%) on MNQ in the OOS period.
hypotheses.primary_definition: AMB-01=3bars, AMB-04=wick, AMB-05=15m/5m, AMB-06=3bars, AMB-07=4ticks, AMB-08=proximal, AMB-09=full_range
hypotheses.null: Win rate ≤ 26% (setup has no edge above transaction costs at 3R)
hypotheses.null_rationale: At 3R with $7.50 round-trip cost, a win rate of 26% produces zero expected value. The null represents no economic edge.
hypotheses.baseline: Random entry on MNQ 5m bars with 3R target and fixed stop: expected win rate ≈ 25% (geometric probability). This is the economically valid baseline.

hypotheses.name: Entry Type 1 vs Entry Type 2 Win Rate
hypotheses.description: Entry Type 1 (next candle open after CSD) and Entry Type 2 (FVG retracement) have different win rates.
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate differs between Entry Type 1 and Entry Type 2 by more than 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate difference between Entry Type 1 and Entry Type 2 ≤ 5 percentage points (entry type has no material effect on win rate)
hypotheses.null_rationale: A difference of ≤ 5pp is not economically meaningful given the noise in win rate estimates at typical sample sizes.
hypotheses.baseline: No prior data. Null is set at the minimum economically meaningful difference.
hypotheses.pass_rule: abs(win_rate_T1 - win_rate_T2) > 5.0 AND n_trades_each >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036

hypotheses.name: SMT Confirmation Effect
hypotheses.description: Setups with SMT divergence confirmation have a higher win rate than setups without SMT.
hypotheses.primary_definition: SMT requires synchronized bars from NQ (correlated instrument)
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate with SMT > win rate without SMT by more than 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate with SMT ≤ win rate without SMT + 5 percentage points (SMT confirmation has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: SMT requires additional data infrastructure. It is only worth implementing if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.baseline: H-02 win rate (baseline setup without SMT filter).
hypotheses.pass_rule: win_rate_with_smt - win_rate_without_smt > 5.0 AND n_smt_trades >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036

hypotheses.name: Session Regime: New York vs London
hypotheses.description: The setup has a higher win rate during the New York session (08:30–11:00 ET) than during the London session (02:00–05:00 ET).
hypotheses.primary_definition: NY session = 08:30–11:00 ET; London session = 02:00–05:00 ET
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate NY > win rate London by more than 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate NY ≤ win rate London + 5 percentage points (session has no material effect on win rate)
hypotheses.null_rationale: Session timing is a free filter. It is only worth applying if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.pass_rule: win_rate_ny - win_rate_london > 5.0 AND n_ny >= 30 AND n_london >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: win_rate_ny - win_rate_london <= 5.0 AND n_ny >= 30 AND n_london >= 30

hypotheses.name: Trend Regime: ADX Filter
hypotheses.description: The setup has a higher win rate when ADX-14 > 20 (trending regime) than when ADX-14 ≤ 20 (ranging regime).
hypotheses.primary_definition: ADX-14 computed on HTF (15m) bars; threshold = 20
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate ADX>20 > win rate ADX≤20 by more than 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate ADX>20 ≤ win rate ADX≤20 + 5 percentage points (ADX regime has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: ADX is a free filter. It is only worth applying if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.pass_rule: win_rate_trending - win_rate_ranging > 5.0 AND n_trending >= 30 AND n_ranging >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: win_rate_trending - win_rate_ranging <= 5.0 AND n_trending >= 30 AND n_ranging >= 30

hypotheses.name: VWAP Location Filter
hypotheses.description: Bullish setups above VWAP and bearish setups below VWAP have a higher win rate than setups on the wrong side of VWAP.
hypotheses.primary_definition: VWAP computed as daily session VWAP on LTF (5m) bars
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate aligned > win rate misaligned by more than 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate aligned ≤ win rate misaligned + 5 percentage points (VWAP alignment has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: VWAP is a free filter. It is only worth applying if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.baseline: H-02 win rate (all VWAP positions combined).
hypotheses.pass_rule: win_rate_aligned - win_rate_misaligned > 5.0 AND n_aligned >= 30 AND n_misaligned >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: win_rate_aligned - win_rate_misaligned <= 5.0 AND n_aligned >= 30 AND n_misaligned >= 30

hypotheses.name: Bullish vs Bearish Direction Asymmetry
hypotheses.description: Bullish setups and bearish setups have materially different win rates on MNQ.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Direction determined by DOL location relative to current price
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate difference between bullish and bearish setups > 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate difference between bullish and bearish setups ≤ 5 percentage points (direction has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: MNQ has a long-term upward bias. A directional asymmetry would be expected. The null represents no material asymmetry.
hypotheses.pass_rule: abs(win_rate_bull - win_rate_bear) > 5.0 AND n_bull >= 30 AND n_bear >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(win_rate_bull - win_rate_bear) <= 5.0 AND n_bull >= 30 AND n_bear >= 30

hypotheses.name: CSD Rule 1 vs Rule 2 Win Rate
hypotheses.description: Setups using CSD Rule 1 (midpoint close) have a different win rate than setups using CSD Rule 2 (full-body close).
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate Rule 1 vs Rule 2 difference > 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate Rule 1 vs Rule 2 difference ≤ 5 percentage points (CSD rule variant has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: CSD rule selection is a free parameter (AMB-09). It is only worth distinguishing if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.baseline: H-02 win rate (both CSD rules combined).
hypotheses.pass_rule: abs(win_rate_rule1 - win_rate_rule2) > 5.0 AND n_rule1 >= 30 AND n_rule2 >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(win_rate_rule1 - win_rate_rule2) <= 5.0 AND n_rule1 >= 30 AND n_rule2 >= 30

hypotheses.name: Sweep Type: Wick vs Close-Through
hypotheses.description: Setups using wick-penetration sweep definition (AMB-04 primary) have a different win rate than setups using close-through sweep definition.
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate wick vs close-through difference > 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate wick vs close-through difference ≤ 5 percentage points (sweep definition has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: Sweep definition is a free parameter (AMB-04). It is only worth distinguishing if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.pass_rule: abs(win_rate_wick - win_rate_close) > 5.0 AND n_wick >= 30 AND n_close >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(win_rate_wick - win_rate_close) <= 5.0 AND n_wick >= 30 AND n_close >= 30

hypotheses.name: Timeframe Pair: 15m/5m vs 30m/5m
hypotheses.description: The 15m/5m timeframe pair (AMB-05 primary) produces a different win rate than the 30m/5m pair.
hypotheses.alternative: Win rate 15m/5m vs 30m/5m difference > 5 percentage points
hypotheses.null: Win rate 15m/5m vs 30m/5m difference ≤ 5 percentage points (timeframe pair has no material effect)
hypotheses.null_rationale: Timeframe pair is a free parameter (AMB-05). It is only worth distinguishing if it adds ≥ 5pp win rate improvement.
hypotheses.pass_rule: abs(win_rate_15m5m - win_rate_30m5m) > 5.0 AND n_15m5m >= 30 AND n_30m5m >= 30 AND p_value < 0.0036
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(win_rate_15m5m - win_rate_30m5m) <= 5.0 AND n_15m5m >= 30 AND n_30m5m >= 30

hypotheses.name: Walk-Forward Stability
hypotheses.description: The setup win rate is stable across time: at least 3 of 5 walk-forward folds are profitable (win rate > 26%).
hypotheses.primary_definition: AMB-01=3bars, AMB-04=wick, AMB-05=15m/5m, AMB-06=3bars, AMB-07=4ticks, AMB-08=proximal, AMB-09=full_range
hypotheses.alternative: At least 3 of 5 walk-forward folds have win rate > 26%
hypotheses.null: Fewer than 3 of 5 walk-forward folds have win rate > 26% (setup is not stable across time)
hypotheses.null_rationale: A setup that is profitable in only 2 of 5 periods is not reliable enough for live trading.

hypotheses.name: Portfolio Uniqueness vs Existing Models
hypotheses.description: The Payout Vault setup has a trade overlap rate of less than 30% with the existing Atlas Nexus portfolio (A1, A3, B1, SB1, ORB-1).
hypotheses.primary_definition: Overlap = same bar entry within ±1 bar of any existing model entry
hypotheses.null: Trade overlap rate ≥ 30% (setup duplicates existing portfolio coverage)
hypotheses.null_rationale: A setup that overlaps ≥ 30% with existing models adds little portfolio diversification and increases correlated drawdown risk.
hypotheses.baseline: Existing portfolio trade log from Sprint 123A.8 OOS period.

hypotheses.name: CSD Confirmation Window Sensitivity
hypotheses.description: The win rate is not materially sensitive to the CSD confirmation window (AMB-01): the difference between window=1, window=3, and window=5 is less than 5 percentage points.
hypotheses.alternative: Max win rate difference across window variants ≤ 5 percentage points (robust to window choice)
hypotheses.null: Max win rate difference across window variants > 5 percentage points (setup is sensitive to window choice, indicating overfitting risk)
hypotheses.null_rationale: A setup that is sensitive to a single parameter is at high risk of overfitting. The null represents the failure mode.

experiment_plan.name: Baseline Frequency Scan
experiment_plan.description: Run the 4-step setup detector on the full dataset (train + val + OOS). Count qualifying setups per week. Gate: if < 2/week in OOS, halt all Payout Vault research.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: mean_setups_per_week >= 2.0 in OOS period. FAIL → halt research.

experiment_plan.name: Baseline Expectancy Measurement
experiment_plan.description: Run the 4-step setup detector on the OOS period with primary definitions. Measure win rate, profit factor, expectancy. Gate: if win rate ≤ 26% and n ≥ 30, reject H-02.
experiment_plan.data: MNQ 5m canonical dataset, OOS period only (2025-10-01 to 2026-07-20)
experiment_plan.gate_condition: win_rate > 26% AND n >= 30. FAIL → reject H-02, halt research.

experiment_plan.name: Entry Type Comparison
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate and expectancy for Entry Type 1 vs Entry Type 2 on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: SMT Confirmation Effect
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate with and without SMT divergence confirmation. Requires NQ correlated instrument data.
experiment_plan.data: MNQ + NQ 5m synchronized bars, OOS period

experiment_plan.name: Session Regime Analysis
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate by session (NY, London, Asia, Overnight) on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: Trend Regime: ADX Filter
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate in trending (ADX>20) vs ranging (ADX≤20) regimes on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: VWAP Location Filter
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate for setups aligned vs misaligned with daily VWAP on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: Directional Asymmetry
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate for bullish vs bearish setups on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: CSD Rule Variant Comparison
experiment_plan.description: Compare win rate for CSD Rule 1 (midpoint) vs Rule 2 (full-body) on the OOS period.

experiment_plan.name: Sweep Type Sensitivity

experiment_plan.name: Full Sensitivity Matrix
experiment_plan.description: Run all 7 primary ambiguity parameters × 2–3 alternatives in a full sensitivity matrix. Report the range of win rates across all 128 parameter combinations. Gate: if the primary definition is not in the top quartile of the sensitivity matrix, flag for review.
